result_json.message: docs: add plan review for OpenCode 2.x upgrade

items.title: Remove SDK-dependent dead modules before the Phase 1 typecheck gate
items.reason: Phase 1 removes @opencode-ai/sdk and requires typecheck, but Phase 2 alone deletes TUI modules and tests still importing it; tsconfig includes those files.
items.failure: Phase 1 cannot satisfy its completion gate.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Reorder the already accepted dead-path deletion before dependency removal, updating phase and debt-target references.

items.title: Specify background native delegation and correct orchestrator continuation instructions
items.reason: V2 subagent launch returns a session identity, not completed verdict JSON. Renaming tokens leaves examples immediately validating the launch result, and the orchestrator body retains hard-coded task_id references.
items.failure: Native workflows validate launch acknowledgments prematurely and fail to resume the intended reviewer.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Use existing harness rendering to separate launch/sessionID from correlated background completion JSON, replace orchestrator task_id references, and test installed delegation and continuation while preserving Cursor output.

items.title: Preserve terminal failure semantics and server-side progress in polling recovery
items.reason: The fallback accepts any set outcome without specifying failed/interrupted handling and compares time.idle with promptStart without a server-side admission anchor. Failed turns can become done results, and external-server clock skew can misclassify completion.
items.failure: SSE loss converts failed/interrupted execution into success or hangs a completed external invocation.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Share terminal-outcome handling between SSE and polling, anchor completion to admitted-prompt/server-side progress rather than client wall time, and test stale outcomes, all terminal states, clock skew, timeout, and cancellation.

items.title: Recover turn text when compaction removes the prompt from active context
items.reason: The specified text extraction searches session.context after the prompt ID, but the API returns only active context after the last compaction. Long turns can lose that boundary and earlier response entries.
items.failure: A successful long-running invocation returns empty, incomplete, or unrelated text after compaction.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Specify a paginated durable session.message.list fallback anchored to the admitted prompt, explicit missing-boundary failure, and compaction/multipage tests.

items.title: Avoid copying nested-object and string-brace defects into the new extractor
items.reason: The mandated Cursor source scanner selects inner objects in prose-prefixed nested JSON and counts braces inside strings. Direct reproduction returned only metadata for a valid status object and rejected another valid object.
items.failure: Valid structured author/reviewer results become invalid extracted values or unnecessary extraction failures.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Preserve extraction precedence but implement quote/escape-aware top-level candidate scanning in the new OpenCode module; test nested objects, escaped quotes, string braces, multiple objects, and arrays containing objects. Leave Cursor unchanged.

items.title: Make external-mode acceptance and factory-verification evidence executable
items.reason: AC1 promises real external operation, but the live test is managed-only and manual invoke never configures an external URL. The existing construction-only factory test also conflicts with mandatory external verify and can mask failures in its catch branch.
items.failure: External authentication/lifecycle regressions ship without acceptance evidence, while a factory unit test performs network I/O or passes for the wrong reason.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Test factory verify and failure cleanup with an injected fake client/fetch; keep construction-only assertions on createExternal. Extend the existing opt-in fixture to authenticated external streaming/structured output and prove external close leaves its server alive.

result_json.summary: Six mechanical corrections are needed, including phase ordering, native background delegation, and robust result recovery/extraction. No new operator policy choice is needed, but protocol corrections require another review.

baselineAssessment.reason: Independent boundary-based estimate: a major transport/concurrency migration dominates; native asynchronous delegation and installed workflow compatibility are cross-subsystem work, while extraction, diagnosis, removal, and documentation are bounded. The estimate was not copied from the author ledger.

creditAssessments.reason: Removing the old SDK intrinsically requires handling its unused importers. The persisted concrete before/after states delete controller, permissions, and routing surfaces instead of porting them, genuinely simplifying the minimal compliant alternative.
